articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin proposed splitting 1 ETH into two paired option assets that always sum back to 1 ETH, eliminating forced liquidations and letting synthetics rely on slow, prediction-market-style oracles.
articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Proposes Options-Based DeFi to Replace Liquidation-Driven Debt Model

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: A multi-million-dollar Polymarket contract on whether Strategy sold any bitcoin by May 31 has been disputed twice and is now in front of UMA tokenholders, reigniting an analyst argument that prediction-market oracles built on token voting are structurally unfit for high-stakes settlement.
articles.title: $60M Polymarket Dispute Over Strategy's May Bitcoin Sale Puts UMA's Token-Voting Oracle on Trial

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: The CFTC-registered exchange has asked the agency to approve perpetuals on ETH, XRP, SOL, DOGE and nine others, pushing the new onshore perps market beyond bitcoin almost as soon as it opened.
articles.title: Kalshi Files to Add Perpetual Futures on 12 Altcoins, Three Days After CFTC Cleared Its Bitcoin Contract

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: The world's largest derivatives exchange flipped its cryptocurrency futures and options to always-on at 4 p.m. CT Friday, posting roughly $50 million in notional volume over the inaugural weekend and bringing a new Bitcoin volatility contract live alongside it.
articles.title: CME Group Processes 7,200 Crypto Contracts in First Weekend of 24/7 Trading

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Pavel Durov said in a Telegram channel post that The Open Network's native cryptocurrency will be renamed from Toncoin to Gram over the next three weeks, restoring the 2018 whitepaper name the SEC blocked. The token climbed as high as $2.21.
articles.title: Telegram's Durov Renames TON's Native Token to Gram, Price Climbs as Much as 19%

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: The OCC-chartered crypto bank is positioning its Atlas network as a coordinated multiparty settlement layer for institutional trading on Hyperliquid, Lighter, and Aave — letting funds touch live DeFi without moving assets offshore or prefunding venues.
articles.title: Anchorage Digital Pushes Federally Chartered Settlement Into Non-Custodial DeFi With Coordinated Multiparty Layer

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: The cross-chain lender that once held more than $300M in deposits now has $2.21M in total value locked, a sub-$2M market cap, and no remaining major-exchange listing — the slow end-state of an October 2024 exploit Mandiant traced to North Korea.
articles.title: Radiant Capital Winds Down to a $2M Husk, 20 Months After DPRK-Linked $50M Heist

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: The official corporate arm of the Dogecoin Foundation is plugging DOGE into the same OCC-regulated brokerage stack that already powers crypto on PayPal, Venmo, Interactive Brokers and Mercado Libre.
articles.title: House of Doge and Paxos Strike Deal to Push Dogecoin Onto PayPal, Venmo and Interactive Brokers Rails

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: On-chain traces show the DPRK-linked attacker behind April's $292 million bridge exploit has pushed the unfrozen ~$220 million through THORChain, Wasabi, Tornado Cash, and Umbra, leaving roughly $1.7 million still sitting in the original wallet.
articles.title: Kelp DAO Hacker Has Laundered Nearly All $220M in Unfrozen Funds, Closing the Recovery Window

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: A security startup says it disclosed a fund-draining vulnerability to the cross-chain protocol weeks before a $10.7M exploit hit a near-identical flaw. Now it plans to publish exploit code for more.
articles.title: V12 Says THORChain Silently Patched Its Critical Bug, Then Told Researchers the Bounty Is 'Permanently Retired'

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Five years after pulling synthetic stock tokens under regulatory pressure, the world's largest crypto exchange opened zero-commission trading in 7,000+ US stocks and ETFs for eligible non-US users and lined up an ADGM-issued bStocks tokenization layer on BNB Chain.
articles.title: Binance Opens US Stock Trading to Non-US Users, Sets Up Tokenized 'bStocks' on BNB Chain

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: A Monday 8-K filing shows Strategy disposed of 32 BTC between May 26 and May 31 at an average $77,135 a coin, with proceeds earmarked for distributions on its STRC preferred stock — the first disclosed sale since the December 2022 tax-loss harvest.
articles.title: Strategy Sells 32 Bitcoin for $2.5M to Fund Preferred Dividends, First Sale Since 2022

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: A Citi GPS report shared with reporters ahead of Proof of Talk in Paris pencils in a 300-fold expansion in tokenized real-world assets, anchored on 10% of T-bills, 3% of U.S. stocks, and a $1.9 trillion stablecoin float by the end of the decade.
articles.title: Citi Projects $5.5T Tokenized Securities Market by 2030 as DTCC, Nasdaq and ICE Move On-Chain

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Cardano's Voltaire-era delegated representatives rejected the Cardano Foundation's 7.8 million ADA treasury ask for the 2026 Singapore Summit, with yes votes drawing 65.21% of stake — 1.46 percentage points below the two-thirds threshold.
articles.title: Cardano Community Votes Down 7.8M ADA Summit Budget, Killing Foundation's Flagship 2026 Event

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Co-founder Martin Köppelmann said the company will make all users whole after attackers exploited the smart-contract module that governs Gnosis Pay card accounts. No loss figure has been disclosed.
articles.title: Gnosis Pay Hit by 'Delay Module' Exploit as Gnosis Pledges to Cover User Losses
